name: Koi Suru Amairo Homestay -Ryuugakusei wa Wanko-kei Osananajimi
original_name: 恋するあまいろホームステイ-留学生はわんこ系幼馴染-
source:
During his childhood, the protagonist homestayed at a certain family in USA. There, he met a girl around his age whom he quickly became friends with. 

Several years later, he was informed by his parents, who are in the USA, that the girl he used to be friends with will be coming to Japan as a foreign student, and she will be homestaying at his house.

"It's been ages!"

And so, cohabiting life with the aggressive foreign student, blond hair childhood friend begins.

[From the [url=http://www.willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/amairo/]official site[/url]]
translation:
童年时，主角曾寄宿在美国的一户人家。在那里，他结识了一个与自己年纪相仿的女孩，两人很快成了朋友。

几年后，身在美国的父母告诉他，那位儿时的玩伴即将作为留学生来到日本，并寄宿在他家。

“好久不见！”

就这样，与积极主动的金发留学生、儿时玩伴同住的生活开始了。

[摘自[url=http://www.willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/amairo/]官方网站[/url]]
